title: Learning Latent Graph Geometry via Fixed-Point Schr\"odinger-Type Activation: A Theoretical Study
abstract: arXiv:2507.20088v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study neural architectures in which each hidden layer is defined by the stationary state of a dissipative Schr\"odinger-type dynamics on a learned latent graph. On stable branches, the local stationary problem defines a differentiable implicit graph layer. To learn the graph itself, we optimize over the stratified moduli space of weighted graphs and equip each stratum with a non-degenerate K\"ahler-Hessian metric that keeps natural-gradient descent and face crossing well posed. We then show that a multilayer stationary network is equivalent to an exact global stationary problem on a supra-graph, and that it admits a penalized global relaxation whose stationary states converge to the exact one as the penalty parameter tends to infinity. translated_title: 通过不动点薛定谔型激活学习潜在图几何：一项理论研究
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一类神经架构，其中每个隐藏层由学习到的潜在图上耗散薛定谔型动力学的稳态所定义。在稳定分支上，局部稳态问题定义了一个可微的隐式图层。为了学习图本身，我们在加权图的分层模态空间上进行优化，并为每个分层配备非退化的凯勒-黑塞（Kähler-Hessian）度量，从而保证自然梯度下降和面交叉问题的良定性。我们进而证明，多层稳态网络等价于超图（supra-graph）上的精确全局稳态问题，且该问题容许一个带惩罚的全局松弛，其稳态在惩罚参数趋于无穷时收敛到精确解。反向模式微分被恢复为精确全局系统的伴随系统，带惩罚的伴随在相同极限下收敛到它。最后，在有限维强单调性条件下……
tldr: 本文提出将神经网络隐藏层建模为学习潜在图上耗散薛定谔型动力学的稳态，证明了多层稳态网络等价于超图上的精确全局稳态问题，并建立了带惩罚全局松弛的收敛性理论及基于伴随系统的反向微分框架。
en_tdlr: This paper models neural hidden layers as stationary states of dissipative Schrödinger-type dynamics on learned latent graphs, proving that multilayer stationary networks are equivalent to an exact global stationary problem on a supra-graph, with convergence guarantees for a penalized relaxation and an adjoint-based reverse-mode differentiation framework.
